flashcard_questions.q: Tiny particles in the nucleus of an atom that carry a positive electrical charge.
Tiny particles that orbit the nucleus of an atom and carry a negative electrical charge.
A build-up of electrical charge on the surface of an object, caused by the transfer of electrons through friction.

flashcard_questions.a: A material that does not allow electrical charge to flow through it easily, such as plastic, rubber or glass.
A force that acts between two objects without them touching, such as the electrostatic force between charged objects.
